title: Apple beats earnings expectations as iPhone sales surge
body: Apple reported record quarterly revenue, with iPhone sales up 12% year over year. Shares of $AAPL rallied in after-hours trading.

title: Tesla shares plunge after vehicle recall announcement
body: Tesla announced a recall affecting 120,000 vehicles, raising concerns about quality control. $TSLA fell 6% in early trading.

title: Fed signals possible rate cut later this year
body: Federal Reserve officials hinted that a rate cut could come in the fall if inflation continues to cool, boosting hopes of a market rally.

title: Microsoft announces record cloud growth in Q4 earnings
body: Microsoft's Azure revenue grew 29%, beating analyst estimates. The strong quarter lifted $MSFT to a new all-time high.

title: Regional bank faces investigation over loan losses
body: Regulators opened an investigation into loan loss reserves at a mid-sized regional bank, and its shares dropped 9% on the news.

title: Oil prices climb as OPEC extends production cuts
body: Crude oil rose 3% after OPEC agreed to extend production cuts through year end. Energy stocks gained across the board.
